RV Life park 1620 (4.5 stars, 40 ratings, $$), read 2026-11-07

values.note: The park's campsites page gives RV sites at $44-64 a night and tent sites at $28-37, the tent sites including overflow RV sites with water and electric. Campspot sells four of those, 'Tent or RV 20/30 W/E' (sites A-D, 25-34 ft, motorhomes allowed on A, C and D), at $32 a night before tax; its full-hookup types run $44 (standard back-in 30A) to $59 (deluxe pull-through). Campspot adds the park's $6 reservation fee per stay and a 3.5% processing fee.

fees.source: https://www.majesticoakscampground.com/campsites-1 ('Prices range from $44 to $64 per night' for RV sites; tent sites 'range in size from being overflow RV sites to primitive. Some even come with water and/or electric' ... 'Prices range from $28-37 per night'), read 2026-11-07; https://www.campspot.com/book/majesticoakscampground (Campspot API, 2026-11-10 one night, 2 adults: 'Tent or RV 20/30 W/E' tripTotalBeforeTaxesFeesAndDiscounts 32.0, 'Processing fee' 1.12, 'Reservation Fee' 6.0; 'Standard Back-in 30 AMP -FHU' 44.0; 'Deluxe Pull-Thru 30/50 Amp -FHU' 59.0; two nights on the W/E type 64.0 with the same $6 reservation fee), read 2026-11-07

values.note: Check-in and checkout at noon. A specific site can be 'locked in' for $10; otherwise the park assigns a site that fits the rig's length and amperage. Cancelling more than two weeks out costs $25, two weeks to 48 hours $50, under 48 hours no refund. Cabins, glamping tents and the rental camper take 2 nights; RV sites showed no minimum.

booking.source: https://www.majesticoakscampground.com/faq ('Check-in starts at noon'; 'you may "lock in" your specific campsite number ... Otherwise, when booking you are guaranteed a campsite that will fit the length/ampage of your camper'; cancellation policy) + https://www.campspot.com/book/majesticoakscampground (BOOK NOW links; API: 'Site Lock Fee' 10.0; RESERVATION_MIN_RULE '2 night minimum' only on the lodging types), read 2026-11-07

values.note: A very few full-hookup RV sites are kept for winter stays from November 1 to March 31, by phone.

season.source: https://www.majesticoakscampground.com/faq ('Our camping season is April 1st thru November 1st.'; 'We have very limited full hook-up RV sites available from November 1st thru March 31st. Please give is a call at 573-365-1890.'), read 2026-11-07

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/majesticoakscampground (API availability 2026-11-10: 11 RV types, 33 sites, rvLengthMax 25-47; 3 tent types, 15 sites) + https://www.majesticoakscampground.com/faq and /campsites-1 ('roomy pull-thrus'), read 2026-11-07. The stored count of 80 came from old note prose and no operator page gives it.

facilities.source: https://www.majesticoakscampground.com/about-us ('Free WIFI', 'Hot Showers', 'Coin laundry', 'Swimming pool (mid-May to mid-September)') + home page ('a camp mercantile for the essentials like firewood, ice and snacks'), read 2026-11-07

note: Wooded campground on 44 acres of oaks a few minutes from Bagnell Dam, with gravel, shaded sites, a swimming pool (mid-May to mid-September), nature trails, a dog park and a bike pump track. Seasonal and monthly sites are sold besides the nightly ones. --Claude
summary: Base $32 (Campspot's W/E 'Tent or RV' sites a motorhome may use) to $64 (site's RV range), $6 reservation fee; Campspot booking; season Apr 1-Nov 1 with a few winter FHU sites by phone; 30/50A FHU confirmed; max 47 ft, pull-throughs; showers/laundry/wifi/store; stored count 80 cleared (no page gives it). Google 4.5/190, RV Life 4.5/40.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): posted RV $44-64 (operator site) and Campspot $32 base for its 'Tent or RV 20/30 W/E' sites (A, C, D take motorhomes, 25-34 ft) + 3.5% processing fee ($1.12) = $33.12/night; FHU from $44 ($45.54 with the fee). Under $50, no gateway needed. Good Sam directory: listed, not a Good Sam Park. Google Maps 4.5 from 190 reviews (open, phone 573-365-1890, at the pin); RV Life 4.5 from 40, $$. Presence: own website + phone + Campspot engine.

FEES BASE 44 -> 32: the stored $44 low (provenance with no method, from the operator's 'Prices range from $44 to $64' for RV sites, read 2026-10-16) is the cheapest full-hookup site. The operator's own Campspot engine also sells 'Tent or RV 20/30 W/E' sites A-D (water + 20/30A electric, 25-34 ft, Motorhome listed on A and D, Motorhome Class C on C) at $32 base - the site's 'tent sites ... overflow RV sites ... Some even come with water and/or electric' at $28-37. Written as the cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome fits; if those overflow sites should not count, the base is $44.

LONG-STAY (seasonal and monthly marketed): 1 price - passes ($32-59 Campspot); 2 nights for sale - passes (Campspot sells one night on 33 RV sites); 3 no application/approval for nightly stays - passes; 4 nightly share - 28 nightly FHU sites per the FAQ plus 5 W/E sites on Campspot against an unstated number of seasonal sites ('Our seasonal sites are generally filled the fall before the season starts. We maintain a waitlist'; 'We have designated sites for short-term monthly/full-time campers'), well over 1 in 10; 5 no homes/lots sold - passes. Occupancy check not possible: the park is closed (RESORT_CLOSED_RULE on every type for Nov 2026) and Campspot returns no types for any 2027 date (2027 not loaded). Not mostly seasonal on what was read.
PHONE: stored 573-365-1890 matches the site's TEL line, the FAQ and Campspot; the home page's winter line says '573-365-1980', which looks like a typo for the same number.
WEBSITE: stored http://majesticoakscampground.com/ redirects to https://www.majesticoakscampground.com/ - update to the https www URL (apply.py does not write website).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept; the park describes 44 wooded acres near Bagnell Dam and no water at the sites. Pin 38.2529,-92.6710 equals Campspot's own park point (38.25293,-92.671097) and Google's.
